overview_description.description: Maintouch provides an AI-driven platform for managing SEO and AI search across strategy, content, links, and paid acquisition. The platform uses autonomous marketing agents that operate on a shared intelligence layer connected to analytics, CMS, CRM, and knowledge tools. Maintouch handles keyword research, content planning, drafting, optimization, and publishing across connected content systems. It monitors and refreshes existing pages, fixes technical SEO issues, and manages backlink discovery, outreach, placement, and tracking. The product also includes agents that optimize Google Ads campaigns using business and performance data. Maintouch is used by marketing and growth teams that want to coordinate organic and paid search execution from one system.
